glm, vendored from [g-truc/glm](https://github.com/g-truc/glm) tag `1.0.3` (MIT or the Happy Bunny License, see `copying.txt`). Only the headers in `glm/` are kept: its build files, C++ module (`glm.cppm`) and `detail/glm.cpp` are not used. Ernie installs these headers with its own, as glm is part of its public API.

To update, replace `glm/` and `copying.txt` from the new tag's archive, delete those three files again, and change the tag here.
